notes: Added missing edge-case handling, normalization, and facade integration hardening stories without duplicating existing schema/core/test coverage.

stories.title: Handle Missing or Unsupported State Board Links
stories.description: Implement fallback logic in provider_detail_service to return a clear 'unavailable' disciplinary signal when a provider's state does not have a supported medical board link mapping, ensuring no broken or fabricated URLs are returned.

stories.title: Normalize State-to-Medical Board URL Mapping
stories.description: Refactor and standardize the internal mapping of US states to medical board lookup URLs to ensure consistent formatting, coverage for supported states (DE, MS, VA), and easy extensibility without altering core logic.

stories.title: Integrate Disciplinary Signal into Evaluate Care Facade Aggregation
stories.description: Ensure the disciplinary signal is consistently included in the evaluate_care_facade response payload alongside other provider quality measures, with null-safe handling and no disruption to existing response consumers.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Disciplinary Signal Edge Cases
stories.description: Add targeted unit tests covering edge conditions including unsupported states, missing provider state data, invalid NPI responses, and URL validation failures to ensure robust disciplinary signal behavior.
